title: R2 fixes: assign_devid ordering and header typedef
description:
Three API/header fixes:
1. C89 typedef: port.h forward-declares WOLFSSL_CTX/WOLFSSL but ssl.h also defines them causing C89 constraint violation in TUs that include both. Fix: guard forward decls with #ifndef.
2. g_tls_safe_mode ordering: currently set AFTER RegisterDevice, creating window where callback runs without safe mode. Set flag before RegisterDevice.
3. g_tls_safe_mode rollback: currently set before wolfSSL_CTX_SetDevId() call; if SetDevId fails, safe mode is permanently enabled. Reset to 0 on failure.
